configuration.evidence: Vary the byte returned by the real MOVX at 08E5 and observe its lifetime through the three recorded caller continuations.
limitations: Local callers, timer byte and receive completions use the declared synthetic fixture; interrupts are disabled.
Only the three observed direct callers are tested; unseen indirect entry paths are not excluded.
The read callback supplies a byte but no external device side effect. Ignoring the byte does not imply that the read bus cycle is unnecessary.
P2 latch addressing is modeled as in the existing controller harness; physical address decoding is untraced.

interface_assumptions.evidence: Local execution of controller routines 0800 and 0899 with synthetic mode-0 completion events; no DSC2847 signal association is assumed.
interface_assumptions.interrupts: disabled by local CPU reset state
limitations: Local routine starts and an explicit caller frame are diagnostics, not reset-started execution.
Byte completions are synthetic events, not a model of serial pins, bit order, or oscillator timing.
Firmware byte order, masks and latch ordering do not identify physical switches, LEDs, sample channels, or DSP connections.
All-byte fixtures vary one payload position at a time, not all possible frames.

interpretation: The byte returned by 08DD is live at its return but dead at the tested caller checkpoints. External read side effects remain unmodeled and unidentified.
